hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $\dfrac{1}{2}$ will map $C'$ to a point $\dfrac{1}{2}$ as far from the origin as point $C$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $C$ is $\maroonD{6}$ units up from the origin.

The image $C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{2}(\purpleC{0})=0$ units right and $\dfrac{1}{2}(\maroonD{6})=3$ units up from the origin.
